page: UpCloud GPU-32xCPU-384GB-3xL4 is a GPU-accelerated server utilizing the KVM hypervisor and x86_64 CPU architecture. The hardware configuration includes 32 virtual CPUs with a shared allocation model and 384.0 GB of system memory, which equates to 12.0 GB of RAM per core.

Graphics and parallel processing acceleration are provided by three NVIDIA L4 GPUs from the Ada Lovelace family, offering a combined total of 72 GB of VRAM. This instance does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through network-attached volumes. One complimentary public IPv4 address is included.

The shared CPU allocation model represents a potential performance tradeoff for workloads requiring sustained, dedicated CPU performance. However, the combination of 384.0 GB of RAM and three NVIDIA L4 GPUs makes this server highly suitable for memory-intensive parallel workloads, including machine learning inference, data science tasks, and rendering pipelines.
